patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring a large, immersive visual on one side and a concise text block with calls-to-action on the other.
Extensive use of full-bleed, high-quality photography for section backgrounds and product category displays, creating an immersive and aspirational feel.
Elegant, high-contrast serif headings are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels, establishing a sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
A muted, natural color palette dominated by off-whites, warm greys, and subtle earth tones, reinforcing a sense of calm, comfort, and luxury.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging browsing experience.
Horizontal product carousels are used in multiple sections (e.g., 'Best Sellers', 'Shop by Shade', 'Shop by Materials') to display items efficiently and allow for interactive browsing.
Immersive category sections feature large, aspirational images with clear calls-to-action, guiding users to explore specific product types like 'Sheets' or 'Bath'.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations to reveal content sections, where elements subtly fade or slide upwards into view as the user scrolls down the page, likely using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.
Horizontal product carousels, likely implemented with a library like Swiper, are used to display multiple items efficiently, allowing users to swipe or click through product listings.

The hero section features a large, full-width video background or high-resolution image on one side, paired with a distinct text block and call-to-action on the other, creating an engaging first impression.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (slight rounding on buttons, product cards, and image corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a calm and uncluttered feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a soft, natural, and inviting aesthetic, achieved through high-quality, full-bleed photography of tactile products, combined with an elegant serif display font and a muted, warm color palette. This creates a strong sense of luxury and comfort, making the products feel aspirational and desirable.
